prompt: The chef (speaks / talks) to the class while folding the pasta and warns us not to add oil to the boiling water.
explanation_ru: В живой речи в значении «разговаривать с аудиторией» чаще используется talk to, хотя speak to также грамматически верно.

prompt: During the neighborhood meeting, the police officer (spoke / talked) on bicycle theft prevention near the train station.
explanation_ru: Для официального выступления по теме используется формальный глагол speak (spoke) с предлогом on или about.

prompt: The tourist thanked the beekeeper for the honey sample and managed to (speak / talk) basic French to ask about her beehives.
explanation_ru: С названиями иностранных языков для обозначения владения или речи всегда употребляется глагол speak.

prompt: Because she does not (speak / talk) German well, she had to use hand gestures to explain her family recipe.
explanation_ru: Глагол speak используется с названиями языков (speak German).

prompt: The costume assistant phoned the dry cleaner and asked to (speak / talk) to the manager about the nineteenth-century velvet coat.
explanation_ru: В телефонном разговоре при просьбе соединить с кем-либо стандартным и вежливым вариантом является speak to (в американском английском также talk to).

prompt: Before tasting the spicy papaya salad, our guide taught us how to ask for less chili in (spoken / talked) Thai.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании «разговорный язык» используется причастие spoken (spoken Thai).

prompt: During his welcome speech, the best man (spoke / talked) in both Czech and English so that everyone at the wedding could follow.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения языка речи (in Czech and English) и публичного выступления используется глагол speak (spoke).

prompt: While trying on bright red glasses, the girl (spoke / talked) with her mom on a video call to ask if she looked like an owl.
explanation_ru: Для неформальной беседы с близкими обычно выбирают talk with, хотя speak with тоже допустимо.

prompt: Nobody in the village can (speak / talk) Latin anymore, so the teacher asked a student to translate the old stone inscription.
explanation_ru: Владение языком передается только глаголом speak (speak Latin).

prompt: The museum guide held up an old leather boot and (spoke / talked) to the group about old shoe making. While he was (speaking / talking), one boy raised his hand. He asked if he could try the old boot on.
explanation_ru: Оба глагола (talk и speak) подходят для описания рассказа экскурсовода группе, но talk звучит более непринужденно.

prompt: The ticket office worker called to (speak / talk) with the buyer about tonight's music show. They (spoke / talked) briefly on the phone, and he warned her that the show had moved to a smaller hall.
explanation_ru: В деловом телефонном звонке предпочтителен более официальный глагол speak, но talk также является верным вариантом.

prompt: Before the relay race began, the PE teacher (spoke / talked) clearly to the runners about passing the baton. Everyone listened closely while she (spoke / talked), and nobody dropped it during the race.
explanation_ru: При инструктаже команды перед соревнованием подходят оба глагола, однако speak лучше передает четкость и официальный тон тренера.

prompt: My brother used two apples and a flashlight while we (spoke / talked) about the moon's orbit. He (spoke / talked) slowly so I could understand why we always see the same side from Earth.
explanation_ru: Для дружеского обсуждения используется talk about, а для описания манеры речи (spoke slowly) чаще выбирают speak.

prompt: After their two-hour draw, the two chess players (spoke / talked) about their endgame moves. Neither of them could (speak / talk) the other's language well, so they used chess notation and broken English.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске для обсуждения игры подходит talk about, а во втором для владения языком требуется только speak.

prompt: During the free afternoon workshop, the librarian ___ to seniors about how to spot fake photos online.
explanation_ru: Конструкция speak to someone about something означает «выступать перед кем-либо на определенную тему»; глагол told не требует предлога to.

prompt: The local student walked the tourist to the transfer platform because she wanted a chance to ___ English.
explanation_ru: С названием языка (English) в значении «говорить на языке» употребляется только глагол speak.

prompt: The fisherman called the harbor office on his radio to ___ with the coast guard about strong east winds.
explanation_ru: После частицы to нужен инфинитив speak, который сочетается с предлогом with (speak with someone about something).

prompt: When his soup turned bright purple from the red cabbage, the flatmate called his mom to ___ about the kitchen disaster.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk сочетается с предлогом about (talk about something) для описания неформального разговора.

prompt: A police officer called our house and talked with my dad about my lost skateboard.
answer: A police officer called our house and talked with my dad about my lost skateboard.
accepted_answers: A police officer called our house and talked with my dad about my lost skateboard.
A police officer called our house and spoke with my dad about my lost skateboard.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: конструкция talk with someone about something грамматически правильна.

prompt: Last night, the astronomer talked us about why Saturn's rings seem to disappear.
answer: Last night, the astronomer talked to us about why Saturn's rings seem to disappear.
accepted_answers: Last night, the astronomer talked to us about why Saturn's rings seem to disappear.
Last night, the astronomer talked with us about why Saturn's rings seem to disappear.
Last night, the astronomer spoke to us about why Saturn's rings seem to disappear.
Last night, the astronomer spoke with us about why Saturn's rings seem to disappear.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk не используется с прямым дополнением без предлога; необходимо добавить предлог to или with (talked to us).

prompt: After the toy show, the artist spoke the children about how thin strings make the dragon fly.
answer: After the toy show, the artist spoke to the children about how thin strings make the dragon fly.
accepted_answers: After the toy show, the artist spoke to the children about how thin strings make the dragon fly.
After the toy show, the artist spoke with the children about how thin strings make the dragon fly.
After the toy show, the artist talked to the children about how thin strings make the dragon fly.
After the toy show, the artist talked with the children about how thin strings make the dragon fly.
explanation_ru: После глагола speak перед адресатом речи обязательно ставится предлог to или with (spoke to the children).

prompt: A tourist in Rome tries to order a cheese-free pizza using the local language, which shocks the waiter. Which sentence describes this best?
options: The tourist talked Italian to order a pizza without cheese, and the server looked shocked.
The tourist spoke Italian to order a pizza without cheese, and the server looked shocked.
The tourist said Italian to order a pizza without cheese, and the server looked shocked.
The tourist told Italian to order a pizza without cheese, and the server looked shocked.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения речи на иностранном языке используется только глагол speak (spoke Italian).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'speak' instead of 'talk': The groom called the bakery to talk to the manager about the missing wedding cake.
answer: The groom called the bakery to speak to the manager about the missing wedding cake.
accepted_answers: The groom called the bakery to speak to the manager about the missing wedding cake.
The groom called the bakery to speak with the manager about the missing wedding cake.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk to в официальном контексте легко заменяется на более формальный синоним speak to.
